profile_text.body:
Salesforce, a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, describes itself on its Slack AI features page as providing AI tools to boost productivity within the Slack messaging platform. The company says its AI helps users summarize chats, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and automate workflows, with Slackbot serving as a personal AI agent that understands users and their workspaces. Salesforce describes its approach as embedding AI directly where people work rather than in standalone tools, and states that customer data is not used to train large language models, with LLMs hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud to keep data within Slack's trust boundary.

Salesforce's AI product portfolio includes Slack AI, a chat and messaging platform with embedded generative capabilities; Tableau AI (Einstein), a business intelligence tool with natural language query features and CRM data integration; and Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce, a CRM-embedded AI system that supports agent functionality. The company states that Agentforce agents can run directly in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. According to SEC filings, Salesforce reported revenue of 41,525,000,000 USD for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026. The company operates under ticker symbol CRM and has significant legal exposure, with 220 cases in California tracked by this site.

Multiple model context protocol (MCP) servers enable integration with Salesforce systems, including tools for SOQL data queries, Salesforce administration, and DevOps pipeline management.
